info.title: Example – Spent fuel pool building
info.scope: Example study to illustrate the tool.

rows.consequence: Pool heat-up and boiling; loss of shielding water above fuel
rows.safeguards:
Redundant cooling trains
Level and temperature alarms
rows.recommendations: Verify make-up water capacity and routing

rows.consequence: Loss of pool inventory to leak detection system

rows.safeguards:
Borated pool water
Fuel move procedures and independent verification

rows.hazard: Dose to workers on pool deck

rows.consequence: Fuel damage, release to pool water

rows.recommendations: Confirm seismic qualification of crane restraints

scenarios.name: Direct radiation
scenarios.description: Exposure to radiation from sources, process streams, waste or gaps in shielding.

scenarios.name: Loss of shielding
scenarios.description: Removal, degradation or bypass of shielding; incorrect source positioning.

scenarios.name: Contamination
scenarios.description: Spread of loose or airborne radioactive contamination; loss of contamination control.

scenarios.name: Loss of confinement
scenarios.description: Failure of containment barriers, ventilation cascade or filtration; leaks of radioactive material.

scenarios.name: Criticality
scenarios.description: Accumulation of fissile material; loss of mass, geometry, moderation or concentration control.

scenarios.name: Decay heat
scenarios.description: Loss of heat removal from fuel, waste or sources; overheating.

scenarios.name: Radioactive waste
scenarios.description: Generation, handling, storage or transfer of solid, liquid or gaseous radioactive waste.

scenarios.name: Radiolysis / hydrogen
scenarios.description: Flammable gas generation by radiolysis or corrosion; accumulation in vessels or rooms.

scenarios.name: Internal fire
scenarios.description: Fire loads, ignition sources, fire spread between areas, impact on safety functions.

scenarios.name: Internal explosion
scenarios.description: Flammable gases, dusts or chemicals; pressure vessel failure.

scenarios.name: Internal flooding
scenarios.description: Pipe or tank failure, fire-fighting water, spray and drainage capacity.

scenarios.name: Dropped and impacting loads
scenarios.description: Lifting over fuel, sources or safety equipment; vehicle impacts.

scenarios.name: Internal missiles
scenarios.description: Rotating machinery, pressurised components, valve stems.

scenarios.name: High-energy line break
scenarios.description: Pipe whip, jet impingement, room pressurisation, environmental effects.

scenarios.name: Loss of HVAC
scenarios.description: Loss of ventilation, cooling or heating; extreme room conditions.

scenarios.name: Electromagnetic interference
scenarios.description: EMI/RFI affecting instrumentation and control equipment.

scenarios.name: Seismic
scenarios.description: Earthquake effects on structures, systems and components, including seismic interaction.

scenarios.name: Extreme weather
scenarios.description: High winds, extreme temperatures, snow, ice, hail.

scenarios.name: External flooding
scenarios.description: River, sea, extreme rainfall, failure of dams or site drainage.

scenarios.name: Lightning
scenarios.description: Direct strike and induced effects on electrical and I&C systems.

scenarios.name: Aircraft crash
scenarios.description: Accidental aircraft impact, fuel fire.

scenarios.name: Nearby industrial / transport accidents
scenarios.description: Explosions, toxic or flammable clouds from neighbouring sites, roads, rail or shipping.

scenarios.name: Biological / environmental
scenarios.description: Biofouling of intakes, wildfire, dust or sand storms.

scenarios.name: Loss of electrical power
scenarios.description: Loss of off-site or on-site power; failure of back-up supplies.

scenarios.name: Loss of instrumentation and control
scenarios.description: Spurious signals, loss of indication, software faults, loss of protection systems.

scenarios.name: Loss of utilities
scenarios.description: Loss of cooling water, compressed air, steam or other support services.

scenarios.name: Overpressure / underpressure
scenarios.description: Blocked outlets, thermal expansion, vacuum collapse.

scenarios.name: Chemical / toxic release
scenarios.description: Release of process chemicals or toxic gases; chemical reactions.

scenarios.name: Ageing and obsolescence
scenarios.description: Degradation of materials, obsolete components, loss of spares.

scenarios.name: Operator error
scenarios.description: Wrong action, omission or sequence; workload; human–machine interface.

scenarios.name: Maintenance and testing error
scenarios.description: Errors during maintenance, calibration or testing; restoration errors.

scenarios.name: Procedures and training
scenarios.description: Missing, unclear or incorrect procedures; competence.

scenarios.name: Work at height
scenarios.description: Falls of persons or objects.

scenarios.name: Lifting operations
scenarios.description: Crane and hoist operations affecting personnel.

scenarios.name: Confined spaces
scenarios.description: Oxygen depletion, toxic atmospheres, access and rescue.

scenarios.name: Electrical safety
scenarios.description: Electric shock, arc flash.

scenarios.name: Hazardous substances
scenarios.description: Exposure to chemicals, asbestos, dusts.

scenarios.name: Manual handling
scenarios.description: Musculoskeletal injuries.

scenarios.name: Non-radiological discharges
scenarios.description: Releases to air, water or ground of non-radioactive pollutants.

scenarios.name: Security interface
scenarios.description: Conflicts between safety and security measures, e.g. access control versus evacuation.

likelihood.label: Extremely unlikely
likelihood.description: Not expected during the facility lifetime (< 1E-4 per year).

likelihood.label: Very unlikely
likelihood.description: Has occurred in the industry but not expected at this facility (1E-4 to 1E-3 per year).

likelihood.label: Unlikely
likelihood.description: Could occur once during the facility lifetime (1E-3 to 1E-2 per year).

likelihood.label: Possible
likelihood.description: Expected a few times during the facility lifetime (1E-2 to 1E-1 per year).

likelihood.label: Likely
likelihood.description: Expected several times; has occurred at this or similar facilities (> 1E-1 per year).

severity.label: Negligible
severity.description: No injury. No radiological consequence beyond planned operational exposure. Negligible damage.

severity.label: Minor
severity.description: First-aid injury. Small unplanned worker dose well within limits. Minor contamination confined to a controlled area.

severity.label: Moderate
severity.description: Lost-time injury. Unplanned worker dose approaching limits or spread of contamination on site. Limited plant damage.

severity.label: Major
severity.description: Serious injury or single fatality. Worker dose exceeding statutory limits or significant on-site release. Major plant damage.

severity.label: Catastrophic
severity.description: Multiple fatalities. Off-site radiological release requiring public protective measures. Loss of the facility.
